# Two holdings that differ in the last place the account can hold.
#
# The fund account is kept to thousandths, so 12.345 units and 12.346 units are
# two different quantities and a search for one is not a search for the other.
# Matched within half a cent — `abs(found - asked) < 0.005` — one search
# answered with both, and with everything from 12.341 to 12.349 besides.
#
# The yen entry is the same question from the other side: a currency whose
# smallest unit is 1, printed to two decimals as `2000.00`, which is a figure
# with no meaning in yen.
#
# What this fixture produces: two fund purchases a thousandth apart, and one
# yen payment.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_finding_a_transaction_by_its_amount.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity JPY
	mnemonic: "JPY"
	fullname: "Japanese Yen"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 1
2026-01-01 commodity FUNDX
	mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	fullname: "Example Balanced Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Yen
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "JPY"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Fund
	type: Mutual Fund
	commodity.namespace: "FUND"
	commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "JPY"

2026-02-01 * "Buy 12.345 units"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Fund 12.345 FUNDX
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
		share_price: "100"
		value: "1234.50"
	Assets:Bank -1234.50 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-02 * "Buy 12.346 units"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Fund 12.346 FUNDX
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
		share_price: "100"
		value: "1234.60"
	Assets:Bank -1234.60 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-03 * "Pay 2000 yen"
	currency.mnemonic: "JPY"
	Expenses 2000 JPY
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "JPY"
	Assets:Yen -2000 JPY
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "JPY"
